nf-scalar.instruction: Use a decorated helper returning one ciphertext; its return must affect the final result.

nf-pair.instruction: Use a decorated helper returning at least two ciphertexts in a tuple. Consume every returned cell in the final result.

nf-nested.instruction: Call a decorated helper from the body of another decorated helper; the inner result must affect golden.

nf-forward.instruction: Define a used helper after its caller in source order. Its return must affect golden.

nf-two-inputs.instruction: Pass both encrypted model inputs to a decorated helper. Both arguments must affect its result; preserve ordered subtraction.

nf-public-argument.instruction: Pass a public coefficient through a p parameter of a decorated helper. That parameter must affect the final result.

nf-identity.instruction: Use a ciphertext identity helper with a direct return of its ciphertext parameter. Use its returned value in the model computation.

nf-repeated.instruction: Call the same decorated helper at least twice; both call results must independently affect the final output.

nf-zero-input.instruction: Call a zero-argument decorated helper that returns a Plain coefficient used in the model.

nf-empty.instruction: Invoke a decorated helper returning an empty list/tuple from the reachable call graph. This requirement is explicitly trace-structural, not output-sensitive.

nf-plain-return.instruction: Use a decorated helper returning a Plain value that contributes to the encrypted output.
